Privacy Policy and Consent to the Processing of Personal Data
<p>Собственник и оператор персональных д: The owner and operator of personal data:
результаты обучения: ответы на вопросы,: learning results: answers to questions, mock exams, topics read, exam date and daily goal
пароль, только в виде необратимого хэша:: password, only as an irreversible hash: we do not see or store the password itself
дата и время регистрации, IP-адрес и тип: date and time of registration, IP address and browser type at the time of registration: these confirm that you gave the consent
создать и вести личный кабинет, сохранят: to create and maintain your personal account, save your progress and access it on any device
помогать с доступом к аккаунту, например: to help with account access, for example issuing a temporary password
считать обезличенную статистику, чтобы у: to compile anonymised statistics in order to improve the questions and explanations
отправлять новости, полезные материалы и: to send news, useful materials and offers, including from partners, by phone, SMS and messaging apps, only if you have given separate consent to this
Где и сколько хранятся: Where and how long the data is stored
<p>Данные хранятся на сервере в Республи: The data is stored on a server in the Republic of Kazakhstan (Almaty), and no cross-border transfer takes place. We store the data for as long as you have an account. After you delete your account, the data is deleted immediately, and from backup copies within 14 days.
<p>Мы не продаем, не передаем третьим ли: We do not sell, transfer to third parties or publish your personal data. The server is hosted with a hosting provider in Almaty, which keeps the equipment running. Data is provided to government authorities only in cases provided for by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
<p>Согласие на рекламные сообщения отдел: Consent to marketing messages is separate and optional: all features of the site are available without it. You can withdraw it at any time in your profile, after which messages are no longer sent. Marketing messages are not sent to users under 18.
<p>Регистрация с 14 до 18 лет возможна т: Registration from age 14 to 18 is possible only with the consent of a parent or legal guardian.
<p>Вы можете узнать, какие данные о вас: You can find out what data about you is stored, correct it in your profile, withdraw your consent and delete your account together with all your data in the “Profile” section.
По другим вопросам пишите по контакту: {: For other questions, contact us at: {c}.
<p>Отмечая галочку при регистрации, вы д: By ticking the box when you register, you give the owner and operator named above your consent to the collection and processing of the data listed, for the purposes stated, for as long as the account exists, in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan “On Personal Data and Their Protection”. The data is not transferred to third parties, is not transferred abroad and is not placed in publicly available sources. You can withdraw your consent by deleting your account.
